newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Arafat to seek support at OAU summit.
newsitem.headline: Arafat to seek support at OAU summit.

text.p: Palestian President Yasser Arafat will attend an Organisation of African Unity summit in Zimbabwe next week to lobby for diplomatic support for stalled Middle East peace talks, a PLO official said on Thursday.

PLO ambassador to Zimbabwe Ali Halimeh told reporters at an African foreign ministers meeting preparing for the June 2-4 OAU summit that the peace process needed international pressure to get back on track.

"We are hoping that OAU will form a united front towards supporting us in terms of the peace process and calling upon Israel to respect the agreement which was signed in 1993 between PLO and the government," he said.

The PLO has a permanent observer status in the OAU and Arafat has attended its previous summits, winning in the process solid backing for his political positions. But the OAU has very little or no influence in Middle East politics.
Israeli-Palestinian peace negotiations have been deadlocked for more than two months mainly over Israel's building of new Jewish homes in Arab East Jerusalem.
